We are Available for business

Offering a fusion of rich South Indian design and classic elegance, Tristar Hotel & Resort has been a landmark of fine living and hospitality in Chennai for the past four decades. Named after the Coromandel coast, the Hotel presents an urban oasis of bespoke experiences for both business and leisure guests, with attentive service and state-of-the-art facilities
